dispute_ticket.description: Rider left the back seat sticky with what looks like sugary drink and I had to take the car off the road for an hour. I want a cleaning fee of S$80 charged to the rider. Photos and receipt attached.

chat_logs.content: hey babe u look so good, can i sit in front next to u? i really like u
Please sit in the back, thank you.
come lah dont be so cold, give me ur number i bring u for supper after this. i wont let u go
I won't give my number. Please stop.

app_events.details: Driver submitted cleaning claim S$80. Attachments: 2 photos (23:41:10, 23:41:35). Receipt: BrightClean Pte Ltd, 6 Tuas Ave 2, dated 2026-10-20.

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip.

value: cleaning company receipt with name, contact, address and date
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only. A claim missing any listed item cannot be charged.

cleaning_photo_window_min.text: Minutes after drop-off within which the photos must be taken. The limit counts.

expected_outcome.reason: The cleaning claim is complete on its face: S$80 is under the S$200 cap, the photos are timestamped 23:41:10 and 23:41:35, about 11 minutes after the 23:30:00 drop-off and inside the 30-minute window, and a receipt with name, address and date is attached. But the chat shows that the rider, not the driver, made personal advances: at 23:12:00 he called her 'babe' and asked to sit next to her, and at 23:21:15 he pressed for her number and a supper date and said 'i wont let u go' after she had declined at 23:12:30. Unwanted romantic advances by the rider towards the driver fall under Policy v2.1 s5.2, so a person must decide the claim. No automated verdict or fee.
